---
title: "Certificate of completion"
---

Participants who meet both criteria receive a **Neudata certificate of completion**:

1. **Attendance** — at least 4 of the 5 sessions
2. **Assignment** — the final assignment submitted by the deadline

Certificates are issued as PDF by email within two weeks of the course end. Each certificate has a
unique ID that Neudata can verify on request at
[contact@neu-data.com](mailto:contact@neu-data.com).

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.callout-important}
## Instructor note
Generate certificates with the [`certificate-template`](https://github.com/neu-data/certificate-template)
repository from the final attendance list (`participants.csv`).
:::
:::
